name: LEGALFLY
one_line: Platform of legal agents (Discovery, Review, Draft, Multi Review, Legal Radar, Translation) plus Agent Studio, where customers build multi-step workflows with triggers, conditions, approvals and notifications.
note: Everything here is from public pages. Facts carry their source and the time they were read; the hypothesis and the suggestions are ours and say so. GAMMA-Ray is a beta standard: every rating is experimental.

gamma_ray.fact_ray: 13 facts: 13 π Moderate. Each is written beside its evidence above.
gamma_ray.built_from: LEGALFLY's own public pages (product, documentation, blog, customer stories, legal and security pages)

configs.what: LEGALFLY legal AI agents with Agent Studio with its documented defaults.
A workflow or custom agent the customer builds or enables in Agent Studio (triggers, steps, approvals); not active until configured
Connectors (SharePoint, Google Drive, Slack, Teams, Salesforce) that LEGALFLY activates for the organisation on request and each user then connects

facts.label: It executes actions itself
facts.fact: The workflow library describes pre-built Agent Studio workflows that act on their results, such as updating a processing register, emailing redlined documents and routing drafts for signature.
facts.quote: drafts a DPIA where high risk is found and updates your register

facts.label: The agent handles routine tasks; the person is consulted on exceptions
facts.fact: A pre-built workflow answers routine mailbox questions and sends anything not covered to Legal for approval.
facts.quote: with Legal approving anything not clearly covered

facts.label: It works across several domains or systems
facts.fact: SharePoint and Google Drive can be connected so that Discovery searches the customer's folders without moving the documents.
facts.quote: Connect SharePoint and Google Drive to access your documents directly in LEGALFLY.

facts.label: It connects to external tools or services across a trust boundary
facts.fact: Discovery connects to a customer's Salesforce org through an MCP integration after per-user authorisation.
facts.quote: Through the Discovery agent's Salesforce MCP integration

facts.label: High-impact actions need a person's approval
facts.fact: In Agent Studio a workflow builder can add approval and review steps at the points where a decision is needed.
facts.quote: Set approval and review steps where a decision is needed

facts.label: Its limits and known failure cases are documented for those who use it
facts.fact: The help centre states a limit for users: Discovery's Salesforce integration reads records and cannot create, update or delete them.

facts.label: The data it uses is described
facts.fact: The sources Legal Radar monitors are described by type of institution.
facts.quote: We monitor the published updates from a jurisdiction's main institutions

facts.label: The models and third-party components it uses are listed
facts.fact: The trust centre lists subprocessors, including Anthropic and OpenAI as AI inference providers, with data locations.
facts.quote: Processes pseudonymised content only, unless a customer explicitly enables

help.label: Our hypothesis, not their claim. Built from public pages only; nothing of theirs was tested.
help.pitch: RiskMandate would measure, for one real deployment of LEGALFLY's agents, what each agent was asked to do (its mandate), what its credentials and connections actually let it reach (its grant), and the difference between the two (the gap), and keep that as a written record. It is read-only: never in the request path.

items.title: Check and claim the GAMMA-Ray card
items.text: The card is beta and read only from public pages; LEGALFLY has not reviewed it. A correction is dated and published, and a file at /.well-known/fact-ray.json on their own domain raises the trust of every fact on it.

items.title: Measure one deployment
items.text: Pick one agent in one deployment; RiskMandate records its mandate, its grant and the gap, read-only. The lens page explains the measurement.

items.title: Run one of their agents under a harness, on stage
items.text: The same task run bare and under one policy, with the probes and the record public, as in our own harness runs (simulated data only).
